description: UK Power Networks' Pipeline Allocation is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction The data shown above constitutes UK Power Networks’ provisional view against the Clean Power 2030 technology breakdowns applicable to UK Power Networks – the information will continue to be updated as we confirm the evidence from our customers. This is for indicative purposes only. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2026-08-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
